sources.entry: 22. YobiYoba - Yobiyoba.com delivers state-of-the-art automatic transcription with a powerful editor and pricing based solely on speech time.

summary.name: YobiYoba
summary.one_liner: YobiYoba is a pay-as-you-go speech recognition service that transcribes audio and video recordings into time-coded text.
use_cases: convert audio files to text documents
generate timed captions in SRT or VTT
correct automatic transcripts with an editor
summary.what_it_does: YobiYoba transcribes audio and video recordings using automatic speech recognition. Its process first detects speech segments, then identifies the spoken language if it is not already known, and finally converts speech to time-coded text. Results are an XML document that is converted on demand to PDF, RTF, CSV, SRT, VTT, and other formats. A built-in editing tool lets users manually correct transcripts. Users can also supply lists of uncommon words, such as proper names, or related plain text to improve accuracy.
notable: Pay-as-you-go pricing from 0.01 € per minute, degressive with volume, billed only on transcribed speech time rather than file duration
Exports to PDF, DOC, RTF, CSV, SRT, VTT and other text and subtitle formats
Custom uncommon-word lists and reference text to improve recognition
caveats: Prices are excluding tax; rates range from 0.08 € down to 0.01 € per minute depending on purchased volume
Automatic transcription cannot be error free, so manual correction via the editor may be needed
